QuestInfo.name: The Truth Behind the Black Shadow
QuestInfo.parent: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus
QuestInfo.1:
Baine's eyes light up as he reads Bart's report, as if he's discovered something! He thinks that the ominous feeling he's been getting recently may have something to do with the Disciples of the Black Mage... Baine thinks it's possible that the Black Mage's Disciples are still in Victoria Island. He wants you to hunt down 15 #rRibbon Pigs#k and 15 #rPigs#k and bring back 1 #bBlack Mage's Token#k.

QuestInfo.2: I've hunted down the monsters and found the Black Mage's Token, and brought it to Baine. I'm afraid there's something much bigger going on than it appears.

0.0: I have read through the report, and just as I suspected, the spies sent by the Black Mage seemed to have gathered some information about us. I believe this is only going to get worse.
0.1: I'll have to report this to Kyrin or Muirhat. I'll need some sort of concrete evidence that shows what Bart and I exactly saw... will you help us find it?

yes.0: I am pretty sure they haven't left Victoria Island just yet. Based on their past actions, I think they are still around here...
yes.1: The monsters nearby might have the proof dropped by the Black Mage's follower. Eliminate #r15 Ribbon Pigs and 15 Pigs#k, then bring the #bproof#k.

no.0: Is this too tough of a task to do? If you can help us out just a little bit, that would be... so helpful. Sigh... I guess I'll need to just report to Muirhat without them.

1.0: Ah, you're back already. That was fast. Did you find the Black Mage's Token?

yes.0: I knew it... I knew they were still in Victoria Island. I have a feeling they may want to collect more information on us. Good thing we noticed them before it was too late. In order for me to write up a report on this to Muirhat, I'll have to start writing up a report on the Black Mage.

item.0: Were you not able to find the Black Mage's Token?

mob.0: You must eliminate 15 Ribbon Pigs and 15 Pigs. You might obtain a clue about the Black Mage's follower.
